description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannelRequest component, focusing on its timeout and error handling behavior within WebSocket sessions.

classes.name: GatewayChannelRequestTests
classes.description: A structure encapsulating unit tests for GatewayChannel request behaviors, especially under timeout and failure conditions.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session configured to simulate delay and connection failure based on send delay milliseconds.

methods.name: request timeout then send failure does not double resume
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that verifies if a request timing out followed by send failure does not cause double resumption.
